problem: Given proofs of P and Q, prove P ∧ Q.

without_documentation.proof:
def P_and_Q (P Q : Prop) (hp : P) (hq : Q) : P ∧ Q :=
  ⟨hp, hq⟩

with_documentation.proof:
def P_and_Q (P Q : Prop) (hP : P) (hQ : Q) : P ∧ Q :=
  And.intro hP hQ

problem: Given a proof of P, prove P ∨ Q.

without_documentation.proof:
theorem add_disjunction (P Q : Prop) (hP : P) : P ∨ Q := 
  Or.inl hP

with_documentation.proof:
theorem proof_of_disjunction (P Q : Prop) (hp : P) : P ∨ Q :=
  Or.inl hp

problem: Given a natural number n, prove that there exists a natural number equal to n.

without_documentation.proof:
import Nat

theorem exists_natural_eq (n : Nat) : ∃ m : Nat, m = n := 
  ⟨n, rfl⟩

with_documentation.proof:
theorem exists_nat_eq (n : Nat) : ∃ m : Nat, m = n := by
  use n
  rfl

without_documentation.proof:
theorem P_implies_P (P : Prop) : P → P :=
begin
  intro h,
  exact h,
end

with_documentation.proof:
theorem id_prop (P : Prop) : P → P := by
  intro h
  exact h

problem: Given h1 : P → Q and h2 : P, prove Q.

without_documentation.proof:
theorem implication_intro (P Q : Prop) (h1 : P → Q) (h2 : P) : Q :=
  h1 h2

with_documentation.proof:
theorem imply_intro (P Q : Prop) (h1 : P → Q) (h2 : P) : Q :=
  apply h1,
  exact h2.
